;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Jongdari]] hits central and western [[Japan]], injuring at least 21 people and cutting power to tens of thousands of homes. The typhoon is the latest in the series of weather events to affect the country, following devastating [[2018 Japan floods|floods]] and a fatal [[2018 Japan heat wave|heat wave]] earlier in the month. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-44990966 (BBC)]
